About_&_Key_Points:
About
Heidelberg Cement India is the Indian subsidiary of HeidelbergCement Group, Germany. The Company has its operations in Central India at Damoh (Madhya Pradesh), Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh), and in Southern India at Ammasandra (Karnataka).
[1]
The company sells under the MyCem and MyCem Power brand.
[2]
Key Points
Segment
[1]
The company is into production of 100% blended cement. The company also produces green power which increased by 33% in FY23.
The production of Alternate fuel is at 6%.
